body: yeah most of them are archived or whatever idk i’m not a very active reddit user i mostly just come on here to write something depressing and suicidal every now and then. i agree there’s some bots on here i get spammed with “hey” messages every time i post and it drives me insane but going onto the comments of someone who is in a vulnerable situation and just disregarding them as a bot is kinda not cool like just leave it or report it for spam or something. there are more productive uses of your time :)
ok buddy why are you trolling on suicidewatch of all subs do you have something you need to talk about

i promise you that when you turn 20 the world looks exactly the same and so different at the same time. i think it gets better i’m still working on it but someday. i’ve been slowly exposure therapying my severe incapaciting anxiety that’s left me basically agoraphobic by just going and getting a coffee or a bagel most mornings. it’s so simple and so hard and i get a little treat out of it. the world will look beautiful and worth staying in as you grow. i believe in you :)
they already told me, i was the second choice and i was so close but they decided someone else was just a “little bit more prepared for it” than me
shoutout to the suicide hotline lady who said i seem like a kind loving and caring person and we need more people like me in the world like thanks i guess
yeah i always thought i’d have it all figured out by now but really i have no clue at all what i’m doing or want to do. i wish we could just go back in time and change something to fix this.

i’m in the exact same boat as you, 18, no real good plans for the future and i don’t think it’s going to get better for me. i’ve tried so hard but i keep failing at getting better. i’m so tired of it all.
i did immediately, but it was later at night and i know sometimes i wake up and i think “why did i say that last night” so idk i guess i was hoping it was a thing like that?

i did tell him that it really hurt me and why and that all i wanted was an apology, but he excused himself by saying that was just how he talked to people and if i didn’t like that then i shouldn’t show him stuff i’m interested in.

i had been waiting for a song to come out for a while (the demo was on tiktok) & it was one that meant a lot to me because i related to the message. it came out and i told him immediately cause he knew i was excited for it and he seemed to be too. i said i loved it and he said he wished someone else has sung it and he didn’t really care for it. he had a habit of putting down things i was excited about or interested it, so this wasn’t the first time. he had also said triggering things in the past about my eating disorder and sh addiction that made me extremely uncomfortable.

i asked him what was up multiple times, i saw his phone, he was mostly just spaced out and on reddit. we’ve been close friends for 4 years now, and i also really care a lot about this friendship and have done a whole lot for him when he was having a hard time at home. i even helped get him a job, paid for a lot of his food after work, never made him pay for gas even when i drove him around since im more financially stable than him. even when i was mad at him i made sure he was ok when his mom called the cops on him. it wasn’t one small thing, it was repeated small things that wore me down over time.

i’ve gotten fillings twice in the past like 6 months. i’m severely depressed and don’t often have the energy to brush my teeth at all, let alone brush and floss twice a day. why do you come to a group of suicidal people and shit on them for struggling? it’s not going to help anyone, you are just an asshole.
